decision: Selected the planar centroid (UTM 18N) of Lehigh County parcel PIN 545408213261, the parcel with situs address 9999 Hamilton Blvd, as the campus locator for TierPoint's 137-acre TekPark campus in Upper Macungie Township, home of the Allentown - TekPark (TEK) data center in Building 4.
layer: PASDA (Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access, the Commonwealth's geospatial data clearinghouse) map service 'pasda/LehighCounty' layer 5 'Lehigh County Parcels 202108' (Lehigh County parcel data, August 2021 edition; native NAD83 geographic, EPSG:4269), queried by situs address with outSR=4326 and by PIN in its native CRS

pa_dep_tracker_point_for_tekpark_expansi.role: corroboration only; undated DEP tracker row for the proposed TekPark expansion

facts.centroid_method: planar centroid in EPSG:32618 (WGS84 / UTM 18N) of the ring returned with outSR=4326, transformed back to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid; the native EPSG:4269 ring transformed locally with pyproj as a cross-check

identity_bridge: TierPoint's Allentown - TekPark page gives the TEK data center at 9999 Hamilton Boulevard, Building #4, Breinigsville, PA 18031; its TekPark Campus page calls TekPark a TierPoint-owned, 137-acre data center campus at 9999 Hamilton Blvd, and TierPoint's 23 October 2025 release reports the acquisition of the 137-acre TekPark campus with its largest, formerly leased data center.

A situs-address query of the Lehigh County parcel layer returns exactly one parcel at 9999 Hamilton Blvd, PIN 545408213261; its polygon measures 137.42 geodesic acres, matching the operator's 137 acres.
PA DEP's data-center permit tracker places its 'TekPark Data Center Expansion (TierPoint)' row in Upper Macungie Township at 40.545066, -75.655952, 44 m from this centroid.

consistency_checks.datum: WGS84 output requested from the service; the native NAD83 ring gives a centroid 0.92 m away
consistency_checks.edition: The parcel layer is the August 2021 edition; the operator's 2025-2026 statements give the same 137-acre extent, so no later subdivision is indicated, but one cannot be excluded.
consistency_checks.personal_data: The layer carries no owner fields; none were requested or copied.
